title: LA Colossal – Cloisonné 02 (Standing)
prompt:
Fine art body painting photography. Subject: ONE extremely large SuperBBW Latina woman in her late 20s, long dark voluminous curls, natural face with a bright smile.

Physique: The most colossal SuperBBW physique physically possible — gigantic soft belly hanging in multiple deep overlapping rolls down toward the thighs, not pregnant, overwhelmingly massive heavy bust resting on the upper belly, extremely wide hips far wider than the shoulders, enormous thick thighs, very broad soft arms, profound physical volume filling the entire frame width.

Body Art: Full body cloisonné enamel body painting in jingtailan style, from neck to ankle, painted directly on bare skin, one continuous surface, no collar band. The body painting is the only covering on the body — no garments, no fabric, no robes, no bodysuit, no leggings, no stockings. Glossy turquoise enamel base with raised gold wire cells filled with chrysanthemums, butterflies, and scrolling vines in coral, cobalt, green, and white. Pelvis, inner thighs, and both arms fully patterned.

Pose: Standing in a three-quarter front view, one hand lifting her curls at shoulder height, the other on her outer hip, torso turned open to the camera. Arms kept away from the torso so the painted bust and belly are fully visible. Full body head to toe visible.

Footwear: Very high 8-inch turquoise enamel platform stiletto sandals with multiple thin gold-edged straps across the instep.
Nails: Extra long coffin nails, coral with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: MANDATORY seamless matte black studio background. Low camera angle, 85mm lens. Warm key with raking side light and soft rim light. ONE woman only. Figure fills 90% of the frame. Emphasis on the extremely large SuperBBW body volume. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
